grants.label: Community Housing Fund provisional grant

why: the gap is $8,839,641, 71% of the cost before any land price, more than the 15% line (this tool's screening line, not a funder's rule); a land price would only widen it
placeholders in use: Soft costs, Contingency, Rent-geared-to-income, Operating cost, Replacement reserve
unsure: land cost (the owner is not a church, a society or a government, and no price is entered)

lines.label: Hard cost base
lines.note: average of Quadplex 01 ($425/sf), Quadplex 02 ($438/sf) and Townhouse ($446/sf)

lines.label: Escalation to the index in force on the run date
lines.note: BCPI 109.4 (2026-07-01, the last quarter published 120 days before the run date 2026-11-23) over 106.1 (2024-07-01)

lines.label: Land
lines.note: not settled: enter the assessed value or the agreed price in the option's finance block

lines.label: Capital cost
lines.note: hard + soft + contingency + land; no land price yet, so this is the cost before land

lines.label: Market rent
lines.note: CMHC October 2025, 4 units; some unit types priced at the CMHC all-units average: the table has no figure for them

lines.label: Rent-geared-to-income
lines.note: 30% of a household income taken at 50% of the fund's income limit (placeholder)

lines.label: Vacancy
lines.note: 3.7% of gross rent, the CMHC survey's rate

lines.label: Net operating income
lines.note: gross rent less vacancy, operating cost and reserve

lines.label: Community Housing Fund grant
lines.note: $171,211 per unit × 12; indicative, the fund is between calls

lines.label: Supportable debt
lines.note: the largest loan the net operating income carries: the lender wants net income 1.10 times the loan payment (the debt coverage ratio), at 6.19% repaid over 40 years (the amortization), $106,166 a year in payments

lines.label: Gap
